node.title: Re: @ARGV and glob
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
But I cannot find reference for this behavior.

As [Corion] [id://1197812|said], this is a feature of the shell. See for example "[https://www.gnu.org/software/bash/manual/bash.html#Filename-Expansion|Filename Expansion]" (and the following "Pattern Matching") in the Bash Reference Manual; of course there are lots of other shells, but the basic behavior of * and ? are pretty much the same almost everywhere.

Under Windows, you can use [mod://Win32::Autoglob] to emulate this behavior.
